lead: The item `orient.py` hands you can already be on disk, uncommitted, from a session that died before its wrap.
body: The next pack opens on the same item as if nothing existed, and re-deriving it throws the work away and leaves two designs for one rule. Run `git status --short` and read the modified and untracked files your item names before writing a line of it; the tell is a `0 commit(s) | (no status written)` line for the previous session in `.loop/log.md`.
